title: Tech Note: Macros in 4D v11 SQL
author: Robert Molina, Technical Support Engineer, 4D Inc.
featured_technology: XML DTD conformity for macro definitions

historical_commentary.text: This note documents incremental updates to 4D's macro system (text/method automation snippets in the method editor) for 4D v11 SQL, including full XML-standard conformity, a new 'Macros v2' folder structure, and new <macro> element attributes, migrating away from the earlier blob-based storage for large macro text. The macro feature itself has been superseded by 4D's modern code editor tooling and templates in current versions, and the specific file/folder conversion mechanics described (Macros v2, Macros.xml, per-OS encoding differences) are tied to a 2007-era editor implementation with limited relevance to current 4D development environments.
related_updates: 4D's method/code editor and code snippet tooling have been substantially modernized in versions since 2007
The specific 'Macros v2' folder/XML file mechanics described here are tied to the classic 4D editor implementation of that era
